summary: Iteration 3 — Validated the new canonical supplier search contract POST /api/v1/suppliers/aliexpress/search end-to-end, plus license/dashboard/maintenance refresh, CORS preflight for the three production-class origins, plugin release pointing at updates.nipsdownloads.com, and full regression of iterations 1-2. 59/59 tests pass (21 new + 38 legacy). Verbatim query passthrough (with spaces, ampersand, uppercase) is byte-for-byte correct. Full rich payload contract (32 top-level fields + supplier object + meta + variants) verified on every result item.

minor.issue: limit=0 silently falls back to default 18 (does not clamp to 1) because `req.limit or 18` treats 0 as falsy. Production spec only mandates the 1-60 upper clamp so this is acceptable, but a stricter implementation would use `max(1, min(int(req.limit), 60))` after validating presence.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1060 lines — still single-file; consider splitting into routers/ (discovery, suppliers, imports, ai, publish, maintenance) before adding more modules.

REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env points at the user's PROD cloud (api.nipsdownloads.com), NOT the Emergent backend. This is intentional per the user's contract-mirroring goal, but means the prototype frontend running in Emergent will hit production. Confirm this is what the user wants; otherwise the frontend will not exercise the canonical Emergent backend.
`int(req.limit or 18)` in suppliers_aliexpress_search treats 0 as missing — minor but worth a comment or explicit handling.
compute_meta() synthesises orders as `feedback_count * 2.4` — fine as a heuristic but worth documenting that `orders` in the v1 contract is NOT a real supplier count.
`shipping_to` is accepted but never used to filter the catalog (only echoed back). The contract docstring should call this out so the production cloud mirrors the same behaviour.

CORS: when CORS_ORIGINS env is unset the code falls back to ['*'] AND sets allow_credentials=False, which is correct. But the production allow-list (dropshipping.nips.live, alloutspares.com, api/updates.nipsdownloads.com) is only applied when CORS_ORIGINS is explicitly set to a non-* value. Recommend defaulting to the explicit list in production builds.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (plan Pro→Business, latest release 2.9.6→2.9.8, BASE_URL override when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is the prod cloud)
test_credentials: None required — these routes have no auth. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY already in /app/backend/.env was used for the real OpenAI gpt-5.2 rewrite test.
seed_data_creation: None — mock_data.py catalog is sufficient. All test-created drafts are cleaned up in the regression tests.
